behavioral_notes.observation: Setting/changing driver_id calls create_driver_history(), which creates a fleet.vehicle.assignation.log row (vehicle_id, driver_id, date_start=today) tracking the driver-to-vehicle assignment over time. On a driver change with an existing driver, it also activity_schedule's a 'mail.mail_activity_data_todo' to-do (assigned to manager_id or current user) asking to specify the end date of the previous driver. None of this is visible in metadata.

Assigning a future_driver_id flags other same-type vehicles currently driven by that partner with plan_to_change_car / plan_to_change_bike = True (a hand-over signal). action_accept_driver_change() then clears those flags, removes driver_id from the prior vehicles, and promotes future_driver_id to driver_id on the current vehicle. _track_subtype posts the fleet.mt_fleet_driver_updated subtype on driver changes.

Daily ir.cron 'ir_cron_contract_costs_generator' (model.run_scheduler) drives the contract state machine: schedules a 'fleet.mail_act_fleet_contract_to_renew' renewal activity for open contracts expiring within hr_fleet.delay_alert_contract days (default 30) and an assigned user_id; flips contracts to expired/futur/open by comparing today against start_date/expiration_date. _compute_contract_reminder feeds the vehicle's contract_renewal_due_soon / contract_renewal_overdue alert flags. Pure automation, invisible to metadata.

Odometer readings are an append-only fleet.vehicle.odometer log (order by value/date). The vehicle's odometer field is computed as the max reading and its inverse creates a new odometer row instead of mutating one. fleet.vehicle.write enforces a monotonic guard (UserError if a new odometer is lower than the current). fleet.vehicle.log.services._set_odometer likewise spawns an odometer log and links it via odometer_id, so each service captures a mileage point.

1 JS file, 0 OWL components, 0 patches; one registry add ('views:fleet_form') on bundle web.assets_backend. Fleet ships an almost entirely server-rendered backend UI (11 forms, 12 lists, 6 kanban, plus pivot/graph reporting) with negligible client-side custom code.

information_flows: side-effect: fleet.vehicle driver change -> fleet.vehicle.assignation.log + manager to-do activity
side-effect: fleet.vehicle.log.contract cron -> contract state transitions + renewal activity + vehicle renewal-alert flags
side-effect: odometer set (vehicle or service) -> new fleet.vehicle.odometer log row

capabilities: Manage Vehicle Fleet (register, configure, decommission vehicles)
Assign Vehicles to Drivers (assignment history & hand-over)
Manage Vehicle Contracts (leasing/insurance with renewal alerts)
value_streams: Vehicle lifecycle: new request -> registered/in-service -> driver assignment -> contract & service upkeep -> write-off
Contract renewal: open contract -> near-expiry alert activity -> renew/expire
policies: 9 record rules: per-administrator full rights on vehicles/contracts/services/odometer + multi-company scoping (e.g. fleet_rule_vehicle_visibility_manager, ir_rule_fleet_vehicle)
Daily ir.cron ir_cron_contract_costs_generator -> run_scheduler (contract expiration & renewal automation)
Odometer monotonicity guard (UserError on decreasing odometer)

classification.rationale: Fleet manages vehicles as physical assets across their lifecycle (acquisition/registration, in-service contracts and servicing, mileage tracking, write-off) rather than producing or selling output. It is a Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support' configuration: an asset-management support activity consumed by the primary value chain (drivers/operations), with no customer-facing document flow of its own. Maps to APQC 10.0 (Acquire, Construct, and Manage Assets) - the enterprise-asset upkeep category.

standard_capabilities: vehicle register with brand/model/category catalog and state kanban
driver assignment with full assignment-history log and hand-over flow
leasing/insurance contracts with automatic renewal alerts (cron + activities)
typical_fits: company car/bike pool management for HR
contract-expiry monitoring with manager renewal to-dos
multi-company fleet scoping via record rules
common_gaps: accounting integration of fleet costs (provided by separate fleet_account / hr_fleet bridge modules, not base fleet)
fuel-card / telematics / GPS feeds (no external integration in base module)
custom depreciation schedules beyond car_value/residual_value fields

open_questions: How fleet costs reach accounting - confirmed to live in the separate fleet_account / hr_fleet bridge, not the base fleet module.
